root_causes.description: The checkout pod is crash-looping and serves no traffic: its container definition was changed ('Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted') and the replacement cannot start because the sandbox image gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest fails to pull (ErrImagePull/ImagePullBackOff), so the pod never becomes Ready and checkout request rate collapses.

evidence.query_or_id: Killing: Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted (count=1)
evidence.observed_value: count=1 kill event on checkout pod during incident window
evidence.expected_baseline: no container definition change / kill events for checkout
0 image pull failures; sandbox image resolves and pulls
frontend ~7.6 req/s; checkout should be same order as upstream traffic

evidence.observed_value: no traces found (checkout not serving requests)
evidence.expected_baseline: checkout server spans present for checkout calls

evidence.observed_value: no logs found (container producing no logs)
evidence.expected_baseline: checkout emits request/error logs during normal operation

root_causes.description: Frontend shows a modest elevated error rate consistent with its downstream checkout dependency being unavailable; this is propagation, not the origin.
No anomalous error signal was observed on cart; it was checked but ruled out as the origin of the incident.

remediation_steps: Roll back the checkout Deployment to the previous working container definition — the 'Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted' kill event indicates a recent spec change triggered the outage.

Fix the sandbox image pull failure: the pull of gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest fails with DeadlineExceeded/ErrImagePull. Verify registry connectivity/DNS, use an accessible mirror or pre-pulled image, or set imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent.
Delete/restart the stuck checkout pod once the image pull path is restored so a Ready replica is scheduled and checkout traffic recovers.
Add a KubePodNotReady/ImagePullBackOff alert on the checkout Deployment and confirm replicas return to desired count to avoid recurrence.
